name: Squid
description: Your bullets swim toward enemies in slow pulses, steering around walls. Each one hits softer.
details: Each bullet re-picks the nearest enemy it can see a few times a second and swims at it with a quick stroke then a long glide, so it arrives in bursts. Top speed is capped (13 m/s in a stroke, far slower on average) so you can still run from them. Lives 6.5 s. No bullet drop. Blocking works on them: a blocked squid bullet turns around and hunts its shooter.
